title: D.I.Z.
description: My cat D.I.Z., through the years.

2009-01-desk-crossing.jpg.caption: 2009. D.I.Z. had just moved in. He liked to play behind the monitor or sit on my lap while I played games, and here he's crossing from one to the other. Skullcandy headphones, a Crytek game on the PC.
2009-01-desk-crossing.jpg.alt: A blurry black kitten stretched across a wooden desk, one paw on a CD and the other on a pair of silver and black headphones, with a Gateway monitor showing a Crytek logo beside him

2009-02-behind-the-monitor.jpg.caption: 2009. D.I.Z. wide-eyed, behind the monitor.
2009-02-behind-the-monitor.jpg.alt: A small black kitten with wide eyes sitting on a wooden computer desk behind a flat-panel monitor, next to a stack of CDs, with a speaker and a holiday glass on the shelf above

2009-03-green-ball.jpg.caption: 2009. D.I.Z. with a green ball toy.
2009-03-green-ball.jpg.alt: A black kitten with light blue eyes lying on a white tile floor with a paw on a green plastic ball toy

2009-04-asleep-with-toys.jpg.caption: 2009. D.I.Z. asleep in a pile of toys.
2009-04-asleep-with-toys.jpg.alt: A black kitten asleep on a white blanket surrounded by colorful cat toys, including a sparkly ball, a pink mouse and a green ring

2009-05-asleep-purple-mouse.jpg.caption: 2009. D.I.Z. still asleep, with a purple toy mouse.
2009-05-asleep-purple-mouse.jpg.alt: A black kitten sleeping on white bedding with a paw resting against a purple knitted toy mouse with an orange ear

diz-01-asleep-on-lap-cartoon-pants.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. asleep on a lap, wearing colorful cartoon-print pants, with one ear perked up

diz-02-curled-in-arms.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. sleeping with his head tucked against a person, paws curled in

diz-03-belly-up-blue-bed.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. lying on his back in a fluffy light blue bed, glancing sideways

diz-04-under-blanket-patterned-pillow.jp.alt: D.I.Z. lying on a brown and tan patterned pillow with a light blue blanket pulled over most of him

diz-05-on-his-back-patterned-bedding.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. rolled on his back on brown and tan patterned bedding, looking at the camera

diz-06-wide-eyes-close-up.jpg.alt: Close-up of D.I.Z. with wide eyes and big ears, in front of a black shirt with a print

diz-07-in-the-cabinet.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. sitting upright inside a wooden cabinet next to a pile of cables and chargers, with glowing eyes

diz-08-asleep-with-catnip-mouse.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. sleeping on his back with a gray catnip mouse tucked under his paw

diz-09-black-and-white-chair.jpg.alt: Black and white photo of D.I.Z. on his back in a leather desk chair with his paws in the air

diz-10-headset-around-neck.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. with a gaming headset around his neck, in a room with an X-Men poster and a bicycle behind him

diz-11-profile-whiskers.jpg.alt: Close-up side profile of D.I.Z. with long white whiskers and one large ear

diz-12-in-front-of-monitor.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. standing in front of a blue monitor, in front of a wall of paintings and a row of trading cards

diz-13-dark-silhouette.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. sitting upright in dim light on a black blanket, mostly a dark silhouette

diz-14-styrofoam-box.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. sitting on a piece of white foam packaging with bits of foam stuck to his chin and paws

diz-15-lounging-beanbag.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. lounging on a gray beanbag chair with his legs crossed, looking at the camera with green eyes

diz-16-plastic-wrapped-mattress.jpg.alt: D.I.Z. lying on a plastic-wrapped mattress with his front legs stretched out together, looking up at the camera
